title.narrative: Strengthening agro-values chain through the establishment of Centers of Excellence in the provinces of Northern Mountainous, Central Highlands and Mekong river Delta provinces

description.narrative: The proposed project aims at modernizing and improving strategic agro-value chains through the establishment of excellence centers, as a mean to strengthen technical and managerial capacity in rural communities, which will lead to income generation and employment.
